identity_boundary.relational_identity: persistent reference entities use immutable opaque SOMA identifiers; names, emails, addresses, account labels and other descriptive/business attributes are not relational primary identity
identity_boundary.authentication_identity: exactly one Local User Profile exists per installation as the authenticating administrator identity; authentication secrets and credential mechanics belong to HLD-13
identity_boundary.operational_people: requesters, handlers, owners, executors and customer contacts are reusable Contact records, not login profiles
identity_boundary.role_model: operational role is relationship/context data; one Contact may participate in multiple roles without cloning identity

CustomerOrganization.descriptive_data: name and supported external account/matching attributes
CustomerOrganization.rule: descriptive equality never independently proves shared identity

Contact.history: affiliation transitions are explicit historical relationships and do not replace Contact identity
Contact.matching: names/emails are candidate-matching data only and ambiguous matches require review

DispatchLocation.site_relationship: zero or one Site may be linked from the Dispatch Location side; every Site has exactly one dedicated Dispatch Location
DispatchLocation.operational_role: delivery, self-pickup, or Fault Tag pickup-origin meaning belongs to the logistics operation, not to Dispatch Location identity

LocalUserProfile.cardinality: exactly one persistent authenticating profile per installation

matching_boundary.ambiguity: zero/one/many candidate state is preserved; multiple candidates never auto-select or auto-merge
matching_boundary.mutation: matching produces candidate/review context; identity merge/reassignment requires an explicit governed command

reference_lifecycle.default: history-preserving archival/reactivation rather than destructive removal once protected history exists
reference_lifecycle.archived_records: remain visible in historical evidence but are excluded from new active selectors/relationships
reference_lifecycle.archive_guard: archival is blocked when it would strand an active dependent relationship

settings_boundary.registry: settings are typed, namespaced, application-owned contracts persisted through HLD-02
settings_boundary.ownership: each setting has one semantic owner module; the Settings workspace is a command surface, not a competing authority
settings_boundary.read_behavior: reading a missing setting does not create a persisted default
settings_boundary.secrets: credentials/secrets do not use ordinary settings storage and belong to HLD-13

delegated_design.HLD-09: Site/Cloud/Room/Rack/Network Element ownership and Site creation semantics beyond the dedicated Dispatch Location relationship
delegated_design.HLD-08: Spare Request requester role, logistics-operation use, immutable logistics snapshots and active logistics dependency checks
delegated_design.HLD-05: import/reconciliation workflows that consume reference candidate matching
delegated_design.HLD-04: ticket relationships that consume Contacts and Customer Organizations
delegated_design.HLD-14: audit/history/transaction semantics for affiliation, archive/reactivate and correction
delegated_design.LLD-02: tables, indexes, commands, exact normalization keys, selector queries and dependency validators
